title: Reverse Engineering of 7-to-1 Sikku Kolam Geometric Pattern
summary: This document specifies the observable geometric properties and hypothesized construction logic of a symmetric Sikku (interlaced line) Kolam. The design features a square/rhombic dot grid configured from 1 to 7 dots with 4-fold rotational and reflectional symmetry, enclosed by continuous interlaced loops.

claims.statement: Target Property: A rhombic (diamond-oriented) dot array labeled '7x1', arranged symmetrically with a maximum axis length of 7 dots tapering to 1 at each cardinal apex.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: A rhombic (diamond-oriented) dot array labeled '7x1', arranged symmetrically with a maximum axis length of 7 dots tapering to 1 at each cardinal apex. (Measurement: 7 to 1 rhombic dot grid (25 total dots))

claims.statement: Target Property: Planar symmetry possessing 4-fold rotational symmetry (90-degree rotations) and 4 axes of reflectional symmetry (two orthogonal, two diagonal).

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Planar symmetry possessing 4-fold rotational symmetry (90-degree rotations) and 4 axes of reflectional symmetry (two orthogonal, two diagonal). (Measurement: D4 dihedral symmetry group (order 8))

claims.statement: Target Property: A closed square/rhombus line segment enclosing the single central dot at the exact origin of the grid.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: A closed square/rhombus line segment enclosing the single central dot at the exact origin of the grid. (Measurement: 1 enclosed central dot)

claims.statement: Target Property: Each cardinal extreme (North, South, East, West) terminates in a teardrop/figure-eight loop enclosing the single outermost dot.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Each cardinal extreme (North, South, East, West) terminates in a teardrop/figure-eight loop enclosing the single outermost dot. (Measurement: 4 cardinal terminal loops)

claims.statement: Target Property: Each of the four quadrants contains three rounded outer petal loops wrapping around peripheral dots in a stepped corner configuration.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Each of the four quadrants contains three rounded outer petal loops wrapping around peripheral dots in a stepped corner configuration. (Measurement: 12 corner petal lobes (3 per quadrant))

claims.statement: Target Property: Continuous curved strokes pass between and around dots without crossing through the dots, intersecting orthogonally at regular crossover nodes.

evidence_refs.cue_excerpt: Continuous curved strokes pass between and around dots without crossing through the dots, intersecting orthogonally at regular crossover nodes. (Measurement: Orthogonal 90-degree line crossovers)
